jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
Eleven Executive Search has been retained by a rapidly growing pharmaceutical company as they're seeking a newly created role leading as Director of Engineering in Northern California.

The Director of Engineering will serve as the senior engineering leader for the manufacturing site, providing strategic and operational leadership across engineering, automation, process engineering, capital projects, reliability, and maintenance. This role is critical to the company’s next phase of growth. The successful candidate will partner closely with manufacturing leadership to evaluate future demand scenarios, develop capacity expansion strategies, guide capital investment decisions, and ensure the site is prepared to support significant commercial scale-up.

This leader will be responsible for building and developing the engineering and maintenance organization while establishing the systems, processes, and technical roadmap required to support a modern aseptic manufacturing operation.

What you’ll bring:

- Strategic Engineering Leadership

Develop and execute the site’s long-term engineering, capacity, and infrastructure strategy.
Partner with Manufacturing, Technical Operations, and Executive Leadership to translate commercial forecasts into facility and production capacity plans.
Evaluate current and future manufacturing capabilities, identifying bottlenecks, constraints, and investment opportunities.
Serve as a key technical advisor on facility expansion, capacity modeling, and network growth initiatives.
Develop business cases and investment roadmaps for future capital projects.

- Capacity Expansion & Commercialization

Lead engineering support for major site expansion initiatives, including additional manufacturing space and future sterile filling capacity.
Define equipment, utility, facility, and infrastructure requirements needed to support future product launches and commercial growth.
Evaluate expansion scenarios involving formulation, filling, isolator technology, clean utilities, and supporting infrastructure.
Partner with external engineering firms and internal stakeholders to challenge assumptions, validate models, and ensure scalability.

- Engineering & Maintenance Excellence

Build and lead a high-performing engineering and maintenance organization.
Establish predictive and preventive maintenance programs from the ground up.
Implement reliability-centered maintenance practices and asset management strategies.
Develop KPIs, performance metrics, and continuous improvement programs.
Create sustainable systems for equipment lifecycle management, spare parts planning, and technical documentation.

- Capital Projects & Technical Operations

Lead equipment selection, procurement, installation, commissioning, qualification, and startup activities.
Oversee capital project execution from concept through implementation.
Ensure engineering activities comply with cGMP, FDA, and regulatory requirements.
Drive automation, controls, and process optimization initiatives.
Support technology transfer, validation, and commercialization activities

- Leadership & Talent Development

Recruit, develop, and mentor engineering and maintenance talent.
Build organizational capabilities to support future growth.
Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and technical excellence.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Manufacturing, Quality, Validation, Supply Chain, and Technical Services.

Ideal Candidate Profile:

The ideal candidate combines strategic vision with hands-on execution and has successfully helped scale pharmaceutical manufacturing organizations through periods of rapid growth.

- Required Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or related technical discipline.
10+ years of progressive engineering leadership experience within pharmaceutical, biotech, CDMO, or sterile manufacturing environments.
Experience leading engineering organizations supporting aseptic manufacturing operations.

Demonstrated success leading facility expansions, capacity growth initiatives, and major capital projects.
Experience building engineering, reliability, and maintenance programs in growing organizations.
Strong understanding of process engineering, automation, controls, and manufacturing equipment systems.
Experience supporting FDA-regulated manufacturing environments.

- Preferred Experience

Sterile or aseptic fill/finish mfg. experience
Experience with two or more of the following:
Vial filling
Prefilled syringe manufacturing
IV bag manufacturing
Experience with isolator technology and aseptic processing.
Experience supporting commercialization, scale-up, and new product introductions.
Experience with utility systems supporting sterile manufacturing operations.

About Us

insightsoftware is a global provider of reporting, analytics, and performance management solutions that unlock the potential of business data and transform the way finance and data teams operate. We empower leaders from over 32,000 organizations to make timely and intelligent decisions. Our comprehensive solutions span Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A), Controllership, and Data and Analytics. We deliver finance teams the insights required to navigate any economic climate and drive greater financial intelligence, while increasing productivity, visibility, accuracy, and compliance. Learn more at insightsoftware.com.

Job Description

The Equity Management team is looking for a seasoned Director of Software Engineering to take on one of the most consequential roles in the organization — leading the Platform & Architecture vertical. Reporting to the Senior Director of Engineering, you will be responsible for greenfield development as well as the core existing application with a mature enterprise customer base and multiple Fortune 100 broker relationships.

You will own the success of a true 0-to-1 platform modernization — a ground-up greenfield project to build an equity platform as an Azure cloud-native application. You will join the initiative in its early phase and drive the teams through MVP and GA on an aggressive timeline. insightsoftware is an AI-first organization, and this initiative is utilizing pure AI Spec-Driven Development (SDD) with GitHub SpecKit and Claude Code in the Azure stack (Azure SQL, Data Lake, Fabric, AKS, Entra, .NET, Angular). This is the single-most strategically important initiative in the organization. You'll partner directly with Solution Architecture, Engineering, Product Management, and UX in achieving cross-functional success. Technical direction for the modernization sits with the Solution Architect, functional direction sits with the Product team, execution sits with the Engineering Manager — your role owns the program delivery and holds every contributing team accountable.

You will also own the existing application ecosystem running the business today — the core CEM platform and all broker integrations that 1,200+ customers depend on every day, top to bottom, from front-end to database. You'll own the stability, health, and delivery of the legacy application, and migration to the new platform when it is ready.

You are the right person for this role if you thrive in leaning into ambiguity and forging the path ahead, are not afraid to fail fast, and recognize that sometimes it's better to proceed without all the facts rather than standing at the fork in the road waiting for the perfect circumstances. Extreme accountability, cross-team collaboration & leadership, client-facing, strong communication — these are a few of the traits that describe the ideal candidate. You'll lead these initiatives with somewhere between 4-6 teams, all with Managers and Senior Managers reporting directly to you.

Responsibilities

Modernization Initiative - Ownership & Delivery Accountability

Own overall delivery accountability for the modernization initiative — defining the plan, sequencing execution, and driving it to completion.
Partner closely with the Solution Architect, who owns technical direction and architecture decisions for the initiative; this role owns translating that direction into a resourced, sequenced, accountable delivery plan.
Continue to push boundaries in Spec-Driven Development (SDD), encouraging Lean and fail-fast experimentation. Grow the usage and adoption of modern AI development practices.
Own Engineering and QA/Automation directly for the modernization initiative, while driving Product and UI/UX as a matrixed, non-reporting partner toward the same outcome.
Establish and enforce delivery standards and definition-of-done discipline consistently across Engineering, Product, and UX/Design.
Proactively identify misalignment, blockers, and undecided cross-functional questions before they surface on their own - engineering, product, and design each report through different leaders, and this role is accountable for the seams between them.
Hold Engineering, Product, and UX/Design equally accountable for delivery commitments. This is a cross-functional accountability role - success requires driving outcomes with partners outside your direct reporting line, not just within it.
Communicate program status with complete candor to the Sr Director, VP, and executive stakeholders — including surfacing bad news early rather than smoothing it over in status reporting.

Broker & Core CEM Portfolio Delivery

Own end-to-end delivery accountability for insightsoftware's broker integration programs.
Own delivery accountability for the core Certent Equity Management (CEM) platform serving 1,200+ global customers, ensuring committed roadmap items and client-critical fixes are delivered on schedule.
Balance capacity and prioritization across the initiative, broker programs, and core CEM delivery; escalate tradeoffs to the Sr Director directly and early when competing demands threaten committed dates.
Serve as the single point of delivery accountability across this full portfolio — executive leadership should get one clear, consistent narrative regardless of which program they're asking about.

Team Leadership & People Management

Own people leadership across 4-6 teams, each led by a Manager or Senior Manager, spanning platform modernization, Broker Applications & Broker Integrations, Core CEM Application, and Platform Services.
Coach and develop the managers and senior managers reporting to you — including calibrating what kind of leadership a given team or program actually needs, and adjusting staffing decisions as needed.
Own hiring, onboarding, performance management, and retention across your organization; partner with the Sr Director on headcount and org design for the vertical.
Shield your teams' capacity from competing delivery pulls; escalate conflicts when external demands threaten committed delivery.
Build a high-trust, high-accountability culture — explicitly encouraging fast, reversible decisions over prolonged research cycles, and rewarding people who proactively surface risk.

12+ years of software engineering experience in enterprise SaaS environments, including 5+ years leading multiple managers or senior managers at Director level or equivalent scope.
Demonstrated track record driving large, ambiguous, cross-functional programs to completion — defining the plan, sequencing execution, and holding every contributing team accountable, regardless of reporting line.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Senior Vice President AI/ML Software Engineer

You will own the technical vision for a multi-agent ecosystem -- designing pipeline orchestration engines, embedding/vectorization strategies, knowledge retrieval systems, and AI-assisted code generation tooling. You will lead a VP-level engineer and a broader team of 4-8 developers. This role is in New York, NY

What Sets This Role Apart
- You build the agent framework, not just configure one -- custom orchestration engine, not a LangChain wrapper - Production AI with real consequences -- extraction accuracy directly impacts financial operations - Full RAG ownership -- from raw OCR bytes through embedding, retrieval, and generation - Evaluation-driven culture -- golden-truth datasets, automated regression, measurable quality gates - Greenfield AI + enterprise integration -- build new AI-native systems that plug into established platforms

In this role, you'll have the opportunity to impact on our organization in the following ways:

Technical Leadership & Architecture

Architect agentic AI systems: multi-agent orchestration, tool-use patterns, planning/reasoning loops, and autonomous decision chains - Design and evolve RAG infrastructure -- chunking strategies, embedding pipelines, vector store selection, retrieval ranking, and context window optimization - Define vectorization strategy: embedding model selection, dimensionality trade-offs, hybrid search (dense + sparse), and re-ranking approaches - Own the AI pipeline orchestration framework -- blocks, inlets/outlets, blackboards, memory stores, and content policy enforcement - Make build-vs-buy decisions across the AI toolchain (vector databases, agent frameworks, evaluation harnesses, model gateways) - Establish patterns for prompt engineering at scale: prompt versioning, chain-of-thought decomposition, few-shot management, and guardrails

Agentic & RAG Systems

Design multi-agent architectures with shared memory, blackboard patterns, and inter-agent communication protocols - Build autonomous extraction agents capable of planning, tool selection, self-correction, and validation - Implement knowledge graph construction from unstructured documents -- entity extraction, relationship mapping, and graph-based retrieval - Develop evaluation frameworks: retrieval precision/recall, extraction accuracy, agent task completion rates, and hallucination detection - Design feedback loops: human-in-the-loop correction, reinforcement from golden-truth datasets, and continuous prompt refinement

Team Leadership

Lead, mentor, and grow a team of 4-8 engineers (AI/ML, backend, full-stack) - Directly manage a VP-level AI engineer; provide technical guidance and career development - Drive architecture reviews, design sessions, and technical decision-making - Own sprint planning, technical backlog, and delivery commitments - Foster a culture of rapid experimentation balanced with production rigor

Hands-On Engineering -

Implement core agentic components: agent loops, tool registries, memory persistence, and reasoning traces - Build embedding pipelines -- document preprocessing, chunk boundary detection, metadata enrichment, and vector index management - Develop scoring and validation systems (Bayesian confidence, cross-agent consensus, golden-truth comparison) - Contribute to platform services (Java/Spring Boot) and AI service layer (Python/FastAPI) - Build AI-assisted developer tooling: code generation workflows, automated test generation, and intelligent code review

Delivery & Operations

Own CI/CD pipelines, containerized deployments, and environment promotion - Define observability: agent execution traces, token usage tracking, retrieval quality metrics, and pipeline telemetry - Manage schema evolution and data stores (relational + vector) - Coordinate cross-team dependencies with platform engineering, data engineering, and infrastructure

To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:

Bachelor's degree or Advanced degree in computer science engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience required. 10+ years of professional software engineering experience - 3+ years leading or technically mentoring engineering teams - Deep expertise in AI/ML systems: - LLM orchestration, prompt engineering, chain-of-thought reasoning - RAG architectures: chunking, embedding, retrieval, re-ranking, context assembly - Agentic patterns: ReAct, tool-use, planning loops, multi-agent coordination - Vector databases and embedding models (OpenAI embeddings, sentence-transformers, FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, or similar) - Strong Python (3.11+): FastAPI, async/await, Poetry, Pydantic, pytest - Solid Java experience: Java 21, Spring Boot 3.x, microservice architecture - Production AI delivery: not just prototypes -- systems handling real workloads with observability, error recovery, and audit trails - Document intelligence: OCR pipelines, NLP, structured extraction from unstructured text - Testing & evaluation: golden-truth validation, retrieval metrics (MRR, NDCG), extraction F1 scores, agent success rates - Enterprise architecture: API design, circuit breakers, caching, event-driven patterns

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building custom agent frameworks (not just using LangChain/CrewAI out-of-the-box) - Knowledge of graph-based retrieval -- knowledge graphs, graph RAG, entity-relationship extraction - Experience with code AI: AI-assisted development tools, code generation pipelines, automated refactoring - Familiarity with model fine-tuning, LoRA/QLoRA, or RLHF techniques - Exposure to evaluation-driven development -- automated prompt regression testing, A/B testing of retrieval strategies - Angular/TypeScript experience for full-stack visibility - Capital markets or financial services domain knowledge - Familiarity with enterprise AI governance: content policies, PII handling, data residency

AI/Agentic-
LLM orchestration, multi-agent systems, ReAct patterns, tool-use, autonomous pipelines

RAG & Vectors-
Embedding models, vector stores, hybrid search, re-ranking, chunk optimization

LLM-
Azure OpenAI, GPT-4o, enterprise model gateways, prompt versioning

Python 3.12/3.13, FastAPI, Poetry, Pydantic, async pipelines

Java-
Java 21, Spring Boot 3.x, Maven, Resilience4j, Hazelcast

Frontend-
Angular 19, TypeScript, D3.js, ECharts

Database-
Oracle, PostgreSQL, vector databases

Infrastructure-
Docker, GitLab CI/CD, Artifactory

Observability-
Agent traces, token tracking, retrieval quality metrics, audit pipelines

The Role

MongoDB is building two connected capabilities that determine how we protect and grow our most important customer relationships: a Critical Accounts program that catches at-risk accounts early and drives them to a durable resolution, and a Customer Health Platform, an AI-powered one-stop shop for customer insights, combining health, adoption, engagement, and experience data with proactive risk identification and recommended actions.

This role owns both. You will build and lead the Critical Accounts function end to end: the framework, the global operating model, and the executive reporting that gives leadership real-time visibility into the portfolio. You will also set the long-term vision and strategy for the Customer Health Platform: what it scores and alerts on, which teams and use cases it serves next, and how it becomes the one-stop shop for customer insight across the company. You will be accountable for how MongoDB identifies, intervenes on, and learns from customer risk, and for where the Customer Health platform goes next.

This is a build role. You are creating the operating rhythm, the standards, and the team structure as much as you are running them.

This role can be based out of our US offices or remotely in the United States.

What You Will Do

Own and Build the Critical Accounts Program

Design and iterate on the global Critical Accounts framework: entry/exit criteria, account archetypes, playbooks, health assessment templates, and Get Well Plan standards.
Design the central Critical Accounts org structure and hire a lean program management team, establishing this as a durable, well-resourced function within Customer Strategy. This team is the connective tissue that ensures every qualifying account is triaged, resourced, tracked, and ultimately graduated with documented outcomes.
Own intake and triage standards so every qualifying nomination is validated, classified, and assigned a process lead and resource plan without delay.
Design the path for Critical Accounts to move beyond human nomination alone, working with Customer Health to define the signals and thresholds that proactively detect at-risk accounts and surface them for the cohort, so nominations come from both human judgment and the platform's early-warning detection.
Own program coordination: the master tracker of active critical accounts, cross-functional stand-ups with Customer Success, Technical Support, Professional Services, Sales, and Product and Engineering, the 90-day checkpoint process, and resource rebalancing as account needs evolve.

Give executives real-time, high-trust visibility into both the Critical Accounts and Customer Health portfolio

Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder engagements under pressure; direct experience with a critical accounts, save, or escalation management program is strongly preferred.

About the Company

My client is a venture-backed nuclear energy startup in Texas, taking a first-of-a-kind power plant from detailed design through NRC licensing and into construction. This is the top engineering seat under the CTO, reporting to them directly and accountable for delivery all the way to first power. They want someone who has already delivered hardware on a tight clock, can make the hard calls in a design review, and knows how to build a team that good engineers want to join and stay on.

What you'll be doing

- Carrying technical delivery for every engineering discipline on the plant: nuclear core work (materials, neutronics and thermal-hydraulics), mechanical systems, the other major plant subsystems, and integration of the whole.
- Running the engineering side of the integrated master schedule, finding the critical path, managing handoffs between subsystems, and raising schedule risk while there is still time to act on it.
- Running every team's design reviews and making sure each decision is captured and traceable, whether it's a change order, an interface control document or a design basis call.
- Making sure engineering hands NRC relevant documentation it needs, on time and to regulatory standard, from inputs to the safety analysis to design basis documentation and other licensing material.
- Keeping the core design and system description documents current as working tools, together with the CTO and COO.
- Planning engineering headcount across every technical discipline, deciding scope, priority and hiring order against program milestones and budget.
- Finding, assessing and closing senior engineers in physics, nuclear, mechanical and systems integration, often competing with national labs and defense primes for the same people.
- Setting up cross-functional teams so the core group and the other major subsystem groups can work in parallel without interface problems piling up.
- Defining how engineers grow, get paid and get measured, with levels and pay bands that run from individual contributor to principal.
- Shaping a culture built on rigor, candor and ownership, where the whole team shares ownership of the schedule.
- Leading the technical side of the biggest purchases, from major subsystem equipment to long-lead core components, writing the specs and RFPs and choosing suppliers for hardware with few commercial precedents.
- Managing outside technical help (universities, national lab partners, independent advisors) that validates designs and qualifies components.
- Owning engineering's interface with construction contractors during the plant build, making sure the site's civil and mechanical work matches plant requirements.
- Putting the engineering documentation system in place (design standards, drawing release, configuration control, and a document hierarchy that serves internal decisions and regulator review alike) while keeping it lean enough to cover traceability and the safety basis and no heavier.
- Building safety analysis into the design from day one, and pushing a build-and-test mindset that trusts test results over paper margin and gets real data in time to inform the design.

What you'll bring

- 3+ years of senior technical leadership on a major hardware program, within 15+ years of engineering overall. Standout program leaders with less time in the field will be considered.
- You've shipped hardware with little or no precedent while the clock was running, in aerospace, defense, nuclear, big-science facilities or another deep-tech field.
- Experience scaling an engineering team: hiring, setting its structure and technical bar, and growing the careers of your reports.
- You treat the schedule and engineering resourcing as a single problem.
- Clear, direct writing and efficient reviews, plus the ability to put complex technical issues in front of investors, regulators or executives precisely and briefly.
- You take the program's success personally, set that standard for the team, and keep it collaborative.

Nice to have

- Deep expertise in at least one of the plant's main technical areas, for example nuclear systems or complex mechanical systems, so you can run design reviews credibly, weigh the trade-offs and challenge loose requirements.
- Familiarity with NRC licensing pathways.
- Having run a program at an early-stage hardware or deep-tech company, with thin headcount, a hard budget ceiling and an unforgiving schedule.
- Supplier relationships you built for first-article or novel hardware that ordinary purchasing processes can't handle.
- Comfort partnering closely with a founder-CTO, balancing technical authority with the job of leading an organization.

What our client offers

- Strong base pay and benefits, plus equity with real upside at this stage
- Full-time and fully on-site in Texas, with regular travel to vendors, national labs and the plant site

You will be accountable for how MongoDB identifies, intervenes on, and learns from customer risk, and for where the Customer Health platform goes next.

This is a build role. You are creating the operating rhythm, the standards, and the team structure as much as you are running them.

This role can be based out of our US offices or remotely in the United States.

What You Will Do

Own and Build the Critical Accounts Program

Design and iterate on the global Critical Accounts framework: entry/exit criteria, account archetypes, playbooks, health assessment templates, and Get Well Plan standards.
Design the central Critical Accounts org structure and hire a lean program management team, establishing this as a durable, well-resourced function within Customer Strategy. This team is the connective tissue that ensures every qualifying account is triaged, resourced, tracked, and ultimately graduated with documented outcomes.
Own intake and triage standards so every qualifying nomination is validated, classified, and assigned a process lead and resource plan without delay.
Design the path for Critical Accounts to move beyond human nomination alone, working with Customer Health to define the signals and thresholds that proactively detect at-risk accounts and surface them for the cohort, so nominations come from both human judgment and the platform's early-warning detection.
Own program coordination: the master tracker of active critical accounts, cross-functional stand-ups with Customer Success, Technical Support, Professional Services, Sales, and Product and Engineering, the 90-day checkpoint process, and resource rebalancing as account needs evolve.
Own executive reporting for the program: weekly account status, monthly portfolio readouts with trend analysis, and quarterly summaries covering program KPIs, churn prevented, and cost-to-save ratios.

Lead post-mortem reviews for every graduated account and route findings into QBRs, product prioritization, and process improvements, ensuring learnings reach the business within one quarter of exit.

Lead Customer Intelligence & AI

Own the multi-year vision and strategy for the Customer Health Platform, defining what it becomes beyond a Customer Success tool: the single, trusted platform for customer insight that every GTM function draws on to understand and act on customer signal
Set the roadmap priorities for expanding Customer Health's reach: new data sources, new use cases, and new next-best-action and AI-driven experiences

Give executives real-time, high-trust visibility into both the Critical Accounts and Customer Health portfolio

Technology Strategy, Operations & Stewardship

Growth Enablement & Enterprise Leadership

Experience, Qualifications, Key Success Measures, & Other Requirements

Preferred Experience & Qualifications

Significant progressive leadership across digital strategy, enterprise technology, data/analytics, integration, innovation, experience design and organizational transformation, with demonstrated cross-functional implementation, adoption and benefit realization.

Digital experience

Greater ease of use; fewer workarounds and avoidable support needs.

Trusted data & AI

Leaders use consistent measures; governed AI delivers measurable value.

Integration & architecture

Core platforms exchange data effectively; duplicate entry and fragmentation decline.

Transformation & adoption

Initiatives meet readiness, training, adoption and operational targets.

Benefits & innovation

Investments and pilots show defined outcomes and evidence-based scaling decisions.

Technology & security

Reliable services and actively governed cybersecurity, privacy, continuity and vendor risk.

Growth readiness

Repeatable standards support affiliations, management partners, services and communities.

High-performing team

Values are visible in daily leadership; expectations and priorities are clear; feedback is timely; people are empowered to own outcomes; commitments are honored; and teams continuously learn, collaborate and improve.

VP of Engineering | Perm | On-site, Texas | Nuclear

About the Company

My client is a venture-backed nuclear energy startup in Texas, taking a first-of-a-kind power plant from detailed design through NRC licensing and into construction. This is the top engineering seat under the CTO, reporting to them directly and accountable for delivery all the way to first power. They want someone who has already delivered hardware on a tight clock, can make the hard calls in a design review, and knows how to build a team that good engineers want to join and stay on.

What you'll be doing

- Carrying technical delivery for every engineering discipline on the plant: nuclear core work (materials, neutronics and thermal-hydraulics), mechanical systems, the other major plant subsystems, and integration of the whole.
- Running the engineering side of the integrated master schedule, finding the critical path, managing handoffs between subsystems, and raising schedule risk while there is still time to act on it.
- Running every team's design reviews and making sure each decision is captured and traceable, whether it's a change order, an interface control document or a design basis call.
- Making sure engineering hands NRC relevant documentation it needs, on time and to regulatory standard, from inputs to the safety analysis to design basis documentation and other licensing material.
- Keeping the core design and system description documents current as working tools, together with the CTO and COO.
- Planning engineering headcount across every technical discipline, deciding scope, priority and hiring order against program milestones and budget.
- Finding, assessing and closing senior engineers in physics, nuclear, mechanical and systems integration, often competing with national labs and defense primes for the same people.
- Setting up cross-functional teams so the core group and the other major subsystem groups can work in parallel without interface problems piling up.
- Defining how engineers grow, get paid and get measured, with levels and pay bands that run from individual contributor to principal.
- Shaping a culture built on rigor, candor and ownership, where the whole team shares ownership of the schedule.
- Leading the technical side of the biggest purchases, from major subsystem equipment to long-lead core components, writing the specs and RFPs and choosing suppliers for hardware with few commercial precedents.
- Managing outside technical help (universities, national lab partners, independent advisors) that validates designs and qualifies components.
- Owning engineering's interface with construction contractors during the plant build, making sure the site's civil and mechanical work matches plant requirements.
- Putting the engineering documentation system in place (design standards, drawing release, configuration control, and a document hierarchy that serves internal decisions and regulator review alike) while keeping it lean enough to cover traceability and the safety basis and no heavier.
- Building safety analysis into the design from day one, and pushing a build-and-test mindset that trusts test results over paper margin and gets real data in time to inform the design.

What you'll bring

- 3+ years of senior technical leadership on a major hardware program, within 15+ years of engineering overall. Standout program leaders with less time in the field will be considered.
- You've shipped hardware with little or no precedent while the clock was running, in aerospace, defense, nuclear, big-science facilities or another deep-tech field.
- Experience scaling an engineering team: hiring, setting its structure and technical bar, and growing the careers of your reports.
- You treat the schedule and engineering resourcing as a single problem.
- Clear, direct writing and efficient reviews, plus the ability to put complex technical issues in front of investors, regulators or executives precisely and briefly.
- You take the program's success personally, set that standard for the team, and keep it collaborative.

Nice to have

- Deep expertise in at least one of the plant's main technical areas, for example nuclear systems or complex mechanical systems, so you can run design reviews credibly, weigh the trade-offs and challenge loose requirements.
- Familiarity with NRC licensing pathways.
- Having run a program at an early-stage hardware or deep-tech company, with thin headcount, a hard budget ceiling and an unforgiving schedule.
- Supplier relationships you built for first-article or novel hardware that ordinary purchasing processes can't handle.
- Comfort partnering closely with a founder-CTO, balancing technical authority with the job of leading an organization.

What our client offers

- Strong base pay and benefits, plus equity with real upside at this stage
- Full-time and fully on-site in Texas, with regular travel to vendors, national labs and the plant site

Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, security, engineering excellence and customer focus.
